title: Centered Kickoff application launcher popup
line: Kickoff can now open its popup in the center of the panel, like the Windows 11 Start menu.
explanation: Kickoff's popup is always placed next to its launcher button, so on a full-width or centered dock-like panel it opens at the edge rather than in the middle, and applets had no supported way to choose where their popup opens. libplasma's PlasmoidItem gains a popupAnchor property (AppletAnchor by default, or PanelAnchor), which the shell's CompactApplet reads to anchor the popup to the whole panel instead of the applet. Kickoff gets a "Popup position" option (Next to the launcher / Centered on the panel, default unchanged) that sets it; outside a panel the popup still opens next to the applet.

commits.message:
plasmaquick: add a popupAnchor property to PlasmoidItem

Applets had no supported way to pick where their popup opens, so a
launcher couldn't open it in the middle of a dock-like panel. The new
popupAnchor property lets an applet ask for it centered on its panel.

BUG: 518337

applets/kickoff: add an option to open the popup centered on the panel

On centered or dock-like panels the popup always opened next to the
launcher button. A new "Popup position" option sets popupAnchor, which
CompactApplet now reads to center the popup on the panel instead.

BUG: 518337

patches.diff:
From 6296b170ec3d3268c708d5d58bb55b80206fed4f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 01:26:20 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff: add an option to open the popup centered on
 the panel

On centered or dock-like panels the popup always opened next to the
launcher button. A new "Popup position" option sets popupAnchor, which
CompactApplet now reads to center the popup on the panel instead.

BUG: 518337
---
 applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml             | 29 +++++++++++++++++++
 applets/kickoff/main.qml                      |  2 ++
 applets/kickoff/main.xml                      |  4 +++
 .../contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml         |  4 ++-
 4 files changed, 38 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
index 025cba4c49..6e7b6fbeec 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -30,6 +30,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
     property string cfg_icon: Plasmoid.configuration.icon
     property alias cfg_appNameFormat: appNameFormat.currentIndex
     property bool cfg_paneSwap: Plasmoid.configuration.paneSwap
+    property bool cfg_centerPopup: Plasmoid.configuration.centerPopup
     property int cfg_favoritesDisplay: Plasmoid.configuration.favoritesDisplay
     property int cfg_applicationsDisplay: Plasmoid.configuration.applicationsDisplay
     property alias cfg_alphaSort: alphaSort.checked
@@ -220,6 +221,25 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             checked: Plasmoid.configuration.paneSwap
         }
 
+        QQC2.RadioButton {
+            id: centerPopupOff
+            Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@label:group prefix for radio button group", "Popup position:")
+            text: i18nc("@option:radio popup position", "Next to the launcher")
+            visible: [PlasmaCore.Types.TopEdge, PlasmaCore.Types.RightEdge, PlasmaCore.Types.BottomEdge, PlasmaCore.Types.LeftEdge].includes(Plasmoid.location)
+            QQC2.ButtonGroup.group: centerPopupGroup
+            property int index: 0
+            checked: !Plasmoid.configuration.centerPopup
+        }
+
+        QQC2.RadioButton {
+            id: centerPopupOn
+            text: i18nc("@option:radio popup position", "Centered on the panel")
+            visible: centerPopupOff.visible
+            QQC2.ButtonGroup.group: centerPopupGroup
+            property int index: 1
+            checked: Plasmoid.configuration.centerPopup
+        }
+
         QQC2.RadioButton {
             id: showFavoritesInGrid
             Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@title:group prefix for radio button group", "Show favorites:")
@@ -292,6 +312,15 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
         }
     }
 
+    QQC2.ButtonGroup {
+        id: centerPopupGroup
+        onCheckedButtonChanged: {
+            if (checkedButton) {
+                root.cfg_centerPopup = checkedButton.index === 1
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
     QQC2.ButtonGroup {
         id: paneSwapGroup
         onCheckedButtonChanged: {
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/main.qml b/applets/kickoff/main.qml
index 6b6c95dabe..24d55f6d10 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/main.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/main.qml
@@ -190,6 +190,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     fullRepresentation: FullRepresentation { focus: true }
 
+    popupAnchor: Plasmoid.configuration.centerPopup ? PlasmoidItem.PanelAnchor : PlasmoidItem.AppletAnchor
+
     // Only exists because the default CompactRepresentation doesn't:
     // - open on drag
     // - allow defining a custom drop handler
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/main.xml b/applets/kickoff/main.xml
index 8f6a44e2a4..264f155d19 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/main.xml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/main.xml
@@ -69,6 +69,10 @@
             <label>Whether to allow switching category items on hover</label>
             <default>false</default>
         </entry>
+        <entry name="centerPopup" type="Bool">
+            <label>Whether to open the popup in the center of the panel instead of next to the launcher button</label>
+            <default>false</default>
+        </entry>
         <entry name="highlightNewlyInstalledApps" type="Bool">
             <label>Whether to highlight newly-installed applications</label>
             <default>true</default>
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml
index 1aba2a5cd9..ac73a5b79c 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml
@@ -215,7 +215,9 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
 
         hideOnWindowDeactivate: root.plasmoidItem.hideOnWindowDeactivate
         visible: root.plasmoidItem.expanded && root.fullRepresentation
-        visualParent: root.compactRepresentation
+        visualParent: root.plasmoidItem.popupAnchor === PlasmoidItem.PanelAnchor
+            && [PlasmaCore.Types.TopEdge, PlasmaCore.Types.LeftEdge, PlasmaCore.Types.RightEdge, PlasmaCore.Types.BottomEdge].includes(Plasmoid.location)
+            && root.Window.contentItem ? root.Window.contentItem : root.compactRepresentation
         backgroundHints: (Plasmoid.containmentDisplayHints & PlasmaCore.Types.ContainmentPrefersOpaqueBackground) ? PlasmaCore.AppletPopup.SolidBackground : PlasmaCore.AppletPopup.StandardBackground
         appletInterface: root.plasmoidItem
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Default panel, Kickoff opened by clicking its button: the popup opens at the left edge
With "Centered on the panel", clicking the button opens the popup in the middle of the panel
Settings before: no popup position option
New "Popup position" option in Kickoff's General settings
Left vertical panel: the popup opens at the top, next to the button
Left vertical panel with the option on: the popup is centered vertically along the panel
Top non-floating panel: the popup opens in the top-left corner
Top non-floating panel with the option on: the popup is centered and stays attached to the panel
